text:
Ari: Quick sync 10: drafting release notes for next deploy. Need snippet update for embeddings, a redirect for a moved anchor, and a short known-issue blurb. Anyone take snippets?

Jin: I can. Tests fail with old call `client.embed_stream()` -> 400. Replacement: `client.embeddings.create({ model: 'rwd-embed-1', input: 'text' })`. Will open PR with JS + Python minimal examples.

Sam: I'll do the redirect. LinkCheck flagged guides/migration/embedding.md#legacy which now lives at migration/embedding-v2.md#legacy-embeddings. I'll add _redirects.yaml entry and update the link.

infra-bot: NOTE: redirects merged after 07:30 UTC will be included in the next deploy. Plan merges accordingly.

Ari: Draft relnotes copy: "Embeddings: SDK request shape updated. Update code to use client.embeddings.create() 10See Embeddings migration guide for examples." Add a known-issue: pre-0.9 SDKs may return 4xx on legacy embed methods. Keep it short.

Jin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2999 (snippets + changelog line).

Sam: Redirect PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3000. Tagging infra for quick review.

docs-bot: Reminder: run `make linkcheck` locally or CI will catch stale anchors.

Ari: Thanks all 10I'll wait for merges then post relnotes in #docs for signoff.
